Title: Genome-scale metabolic model-derived design rule identifies NADH oxidase as the lever for 3-hydroxypropionic acid production in Klebsiella pneumoniae
Summary: Uses a genome-scale metabolic model to identify NADH oxidase as the design lever for 3-hydroxypropionic acid production in Klebsiella pneumoniae, where NADH-dependent 1,3-propanediol formation competes with the 3-HP pathway.

Title: An experimentally validated manually curated genome-scale metabolic model of Enterococcus faecium TX0016 reproduces high-throughput phenotyping data
Summary: Constructs iDR478, a manually curated genome-scale metabolic model of Enterococcus faecium TX0016, and validates carbon-source use and amino-acid auxotrophies against Biolog and leave-out growth assays.

Title: ATHENA: a dynamic metabolic hub balancing carbon economy and energy supply in microbial synthesis
Summary: Designs ATHENA, an NADH-responsive hybrid energy-carbon balancing circuit in Escherichia coli that dynamically trades off carbon-conserving and energy-generating modules for diverse product synthesis.

Title: Reprogramming energy system for growth and bioproduction from CO₂ and methanol in Escherichia coli
Summary: Builds an orthogonal reducing-power system and a CO2-formate-acetyl-CoA pathway in Escherichia coli so the strain can grow and produce chemicals from CO2 and methanol.

Title: Systematic metabolic engineering of Yarrowia lipolytica for highly efficient biosynthesis of mannitol from glucose
Summary: Systematically engineers Yarrowia lipolytica for mannitol biosynthesis from glucose by chassis optimisation, bypath blocking, heterologous mannitol-1-phosphate dehydrogenase expression, and transporter engineering.

Title: Metabolic Engineering of Yarrowia lipolytica for Efficient De Novo Synthesis of Astaxanthin Glucosides via Enhanced UDP-Glucose Supply
Summary: Engineers Yarrowia lipolytica to produce astaxanthin glucosides by introducing CrtX and increasing UDP-glucose supply through competing-pathway reduction and UDP-glucose pathway enhancement.

Title: Enhanced d-Pantothenic Acid Biosynthesis in Corynebacterium glutamicum by the CPSPC System and Spatial Organization Strategy
Summary: Engineers Corynebacterium glutamicum for d-pantothenic acid by combining competing-pathway suppression, spatial enzyme organization, and a dynamically controlled CPSPC system.

Title: Evolutionary Rewiring of Sugar Transporter Gene manXYZ Enables Highly Coordinated Non-glucose Metabolisms in Engineered Lactic Acid Bacterium
Summary: Uses adaptive evolution of engineered Pediococcus acidilactici to rewire the manXYZ sugar-transporter cluster for coordinated co-utilization of lignocellulose-derived non-glucose sugars.

Title: Efficient production of l-lysine by Escherichia coli through systems metabolic engineering
Summary: Uses systems metabolic engineering and 13C-MFA in Escherichia coli to improve l-lysine production by adding sucrose assimilation, a CO2 refixation loop, and lysine-degradation knockout.

Title: Artificial Biosynthetic Pathways for Cell-Free Production of Raspberry Ketone and the Cardiotonic Drug Dobutamine
Summary: Constructs a retrosynthesis-guided two-step cell-free pathway that converts 4-hydroxybenzaldehyde and acetone to raspberry ketone and extends the route toward dobutamine.

Title: Design of a Novel Diamine Biosensor to Guide the Engineering of Escherichia coli for Cadaverine Overproduction
Summary: Designs a diamine-responsive pyrF-based biosensor and uses it to guide engineering of Escherichia coli for cadaverine overproduction.

Title: Metabolic engineering of Saccharomyces cerevisiae for the biosynthesis of indole-derived compounds
Summary: Engineers Saccharomyces cerevisiae for de novo biosynthesis of indole-3-acetonitrile and downstream indole derivatives, including an artificial route to 3,3'-diindolylmethane.

Title: Promoter Engineering in Yeast Cell Factories: Strategies, Applications, and Perspectives
Summary: Reviews promoter architecture and engineering strategies in yeast cell factories for balancing metabolic pathways and improving product yields.
